title: Smart Data Models - ERA ERADIS - DocumentSet
description: Application Document Set (era:DocumentSet's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): A collection of documents belonging together, as they contain - as a set - evidence in an ERA process like registration or authorisation. Inherits attributes from era:Evidence (inlined here rather than via schema $ref, per this repo's convention).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DocumentSet'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

statesCompliance.description: Relationship. stating, through a collective set of evidence providing documents, a (non)compliance, instantiated as a `vpa:Compliance` Target type (Compliance) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

submittedFor.description: Relationship. supporting, holding evidence of compliance in order to enable the Permitting Body to verify and permit Target type (Request) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

supportsCase.description: Relationship. supporting, as a collective set of evidence providing documents, a specific case, as such also supporting the request Target type (Case) is not published as its own SDM model yet.

supportsScope.description: Relationship. supporting, as a collective set of evidence providing documents, a specific, material scope within a case, as such also supporting the request Target type (Scope) is not published as its own SDM model yet.
